# Advice at a Glance

Version 1.9.0 can show the recommended actions of a warning unfolded, which suits the card inside a pop-up, and keeps a tap on them inside the card.

## Recommended Actions

- **`expand_instructions: true` shows the recommended actions unfolded.** Before, the "Recommended actions" panel always started folded, so in a [Bubble Card](https://github.com/Clooos/Bubble-Card) pop-up you had to unfold every warning to read what to do. With the new option the panel starts open and can still be folded by hand. The editor has a toggle for it, and the default stays folded. Thanks to @Marcwa19197 for the idea. _[#108]_
- **Folding the panel no longer runs `tap_action`.** Before, a tap on the panel header also counted as a tap on the card. Inside a pop-up opened with `tap_action`, the card navigated to the pop-up again and Bubble Card closed it. A tap on the panel now only folds or unfolds it. _[#108]_
